periods.analysis: Since August 2013, we have done an excellent job of being a well run city. While for 6 of the 7 months prior to that (Jan. 2013 through July 2013) we were in the black, we really turned a corner in August 2013 and we have achieved double digit surplus since then. I believe this is primarily due to our newfound ability to tightly manage our expenses.
periods.recommendations: With our current ability to tightly manage our expenses and continued consistent revenue growth, we should consider increasing our target for the surplus or we should lower our tax rate. Over the past 7 months we have proven that we can consistently achieve double digit budget surplus. Therefore, I recommend that we lower our taxes by 0.05%.
